Package com.splunk

Class MultiResultsReaderXml

java.lang.Object
com.splunk.MultiResultsReader<ResultsReaderXml>
com.splunk.MultiResultsReaderXml
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<SearchResults>
public class MultiResultsReaderXml extends MultiResultsReader<ResultsReaderXml>
The MultiResultsReaderXml class represents a streaming XML reader for Splunk search results. This reader supports streams from export searches, which might return one of more previews before returning final results.

    • MultiResultsReaderXml

      public MultiResultsReaderXml(InputStream inputStream) throws IOException
      Class constructor. Constructs a streaming XML reader for the event stream. You should only attempt to parse an XML stream with this reader. Unpredictable results may occur if you try to parse a stream with a different format.

      inputStream - The XML stream to parse.
